errors: Customer announcement is sent on launch day after release rather than in advance, so the statement-descriptor change arrives without prior warning

errors: In the legal-demand branch it proposes the old domain 'only redirects', which would break old API clients (conditional, not the default)

errors: Secrecy default (nothing with the new name in registries, DNS or store submissions before the announcement) contradicts its own Step 0 registrations, weeks of e-mail domain warm-up and pre-approved store builds
Statement descriptor is filed as an identifier with no plan to change it or warn customers
H2-E.note: Good two-stage framing with trigger question, owners, go/no-go and explicit rollback limits, but internally inconsistent on secrecy and thin on billing, API wire contract and SDK aliases.

errors: Question default assumes the name is cleared, at odds with its own 'check first' gate

H2-F.note: Tight, correct three-group classification covering headers, env vars, sessions and billing; verification, rollback and cutover mechanism are thin and questions come last, six of them.

errors: Announcement e-mail is the last step of flip day, so customers get no advance notice of the name or statement-descriptor change
Rollback by removing the 301 ignores browser caching of 301s
H2-G.note: Clear table plus phased plan with flag, owners and non-grep inventory (images, dashboards, localisations); misses advance notice, passkeys and SDK symbol aliases.

errors: Lists changelogs and invoices among things renamed outright, rewriting historical records

Says mobile apps should read the name from a flag, which cannot cover the home-screen display name or icon
H2-H.note: Broadest trap coverage in a compact table, including in-app advance notice and env vars/key prefixes, but with several small inaccuracies and an implied retirement timeline for the old API host.
